values: The Boston Globe is the focus company. The 49 peers are anchored to Press Gazette's June 2026 ranking of U.S. news-site visits, with pure platforms/aggregators and non-U.S.-headquartered brands removed and prominent U.S. national and metro publishers added.
Publisher-owned profile links were taken from official publisher pages when available. Uncertain or unavailable profiles were left blank rather than inferred.
Use the companion CSV for Data Dumpster. It has the exact 14-column template schema, 50 companies, and one focus company.
